caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, hand-colored plan of a botanical or estate garden bordered by artistic illustrations of various flowering plants and ribbon banners with labeled names. The central section shows a large, rectangular expanse of land with many small green trees arranged in a loose grid pattern, and a driveway or path outlined by continuous rows of darker green trees. Lower on the plan, there is a grid of six square garden plots filled with pastel shades of pink, yellow, purple, and blue to suggest different plantings. Meandering paths (colored tan) lead to several tan-colored rectangular and L-shaped buildings clustered near the bottom right, adjacent to a larger light blue area labeled the "East River." The left and right vertical borders each include three large botanical illustrations, with the left side showing Bemisia, Origanum Syric, and Hippia, and the right side showing Alexander, Sature, and a duplicate "Alexander," each interwoven with brown ribbon banners bearing their names. At the top left and top right corners are small oval vignettes of large, white-columned buildings with green lawns and beds of pink and purple flowers. The background of the entire image is off-white, with the estate plan occupying the central rectangular space, and the colorful floral illustrations running the full vertical edges. The labels, plants, and garden features are rendered in delicate and detailed linework with pastel and naturalistic hues.
title: Smith's Folly - Mt. Vernon
